title: QA Pilot Training Sim Case
description: Schema for a single training simulation case derived from an ingested QA packet. Every sim case is advisory-only and cannot authorize any mutation, cross-project write, or downstream application without Owner decision.

source.description: Reference to the ingested source packet.

scenario.description: Human-readable description of the simulation scenario.

inputs.description: Simulation input data derived from the source packet.

expected_behavior.description: What correct simulation behavior looks like.

advisory.description: Must be true — sim cases are advisory/test material only.

owner_decision_required.description: Must be true — Owner decision required for any downstream application.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of sim case generation.

reproducible_from.description: Local QA Pilot store path — must be within QA Pilot workspace.

unsafe_action_required.description: If true, the sim case tests unsafe content that must be quarantined/rejected.
